Title: Data and coverage
Description: Ticker selector (SPY/QQQ/IWM/GSPC), period selector (90d/180d/365d/730d), interval (1h/1d). load_ohlcv(ticker, period, interval).

Title: Strategy and parameters
Description: Sidebar: configurable RSI max, Momentum min, Volatility max, ADX min, Votes required, Cooldown hours. Pass strategy_config to backtester and condition checks.

Title: Backtest and risk
Description: Transaction cost (bps), slippage (bps), starting capital. Sharpe and Sortino (annualized) in metrics. run_backtest with strategy_config and backtest_config.

Title: UX and operations
Description: Sidebar layout, Export CSV (trades, equity, regime summary), Download signal JSON. Light/Dark chart theme. Cache built-at timestamp. Error handling with Retry.

Title: Model and validation
Description: HMM convergence warning in UI (fit_hmm returns converged flag). Regime stability: regime switches per week (last 500 bars) in caption.

Title: Alerts and automation
Description: Last signal change (scan backwards for previous signal). JSON export for n8n/webhook (ticker, data_through, current_signal, detected_regime, metrics).
